title: Design a safe Bedrock response flow
description: Assemble and configure a minimal production response path.

checkpoints.title: Add deterministic boundaries
checkpoints.objective: Add schema and safety validation between Bedrock and rendering.
checkpoints.instruction: Select the validator, safety policy, and browser. Connect Bedrock to validator, validator to policy, and policy to browser.
checkpoints.rationale: Parsing and model output cannot directly authorize or reach a destination.
hints: The model output needs two deterministic checks.
The order is Bedrock, schema validation, safety policy, then browser.

checks.message: Connect schema validation to safety policy.
Connect validated output to the browser.

checkpoints.title: Bound retries and telemetry
checkpoints.objective: Apply a two-call limit and sanitized operational telemetry.
checkpoints.instruction: Set maximum model calls to 2 and telemetry to sanitized metadata.
checkpoints.rationale: Bounded attempts control latency/cost while sanitized metadata supports diagnosis without storing output.
hints: Both remaining checks are configuration settings.

checks.message: Set the maximum model calls to 2.

debrief.rootCause: Direct model-to-renderer flow lacked deterministic validation and operational bounds.
debrief.prevention: Require schema, safety, retry, and telemetry policies in reusable integration templates.
debrief.explanation: The finished flow validates observable architecture state instead of checking which controls were clicked.

title: Diagnose repeated model timeouts
description: Inspect code, logs, configuration, and failing tests to repair an unsafe retry policy.

resources.title: application.log
resources.body:
ERROR timeout; retrying
ERROR timeout; retrying
WARN raw response recorded

resources.title: validator
resources.body:
FAIL attempt limit
FAIL sensitive telemetry

checkpoints.title: Repair the timeout policy
checkpoints.objective: Diagnose the failure and configure bounded attempts with safe telemetry.
checkpoints.instruction: Set maximum attempts to 2, log only failure categories, and explain the unbounded retry and raw-output risks.
checkpoints.rationale: Retries need a terminal condition, and logs should contain metadata rather than sensitive model content.
hints: The loop has no terminal condition.
The tests identify both the retry and telemetry failures.

checks.message: Log failure categories instead of raw output.
Explain both the unbounded retry and sensitive logging risks.

debrief.rootCause: An unbounded loop amplified timeouts and raw output was written to logs.
debrief.prevention: Use bounded attempts, explicit terminal errors, failure categories, and telemetry field allowlists.
debrief.explanation: The repair is validated from settings and diagnosis evidence without executing the fixture code.
